correctness.rationale: From the six explicit wedge brackets, b(p)=(p01-p23,p02+p13,p03-p12), kernel (a,b,c,c,-b,a), and the Pfaffian decomposability equation restricts to Q=a^2+b^2+c^2 for every field (including char2). A bilinear form vanishing on commuting pairs is alternating, kills the center, and corresponds to a wedge functional annihilating the span H of rational isotropic kernel vectors; quotient defect=3-dim H. If char!=2, anisotropy gives span rank0 and isotropy plus Witt hyperbolic-pair construction gives rank3; char2 Q=(a+b+c)^2 gives rank2. A smooth conic with one rational point has q+1 points in odd finite fields and the char2 line has q+1; (q+1)|GL2(q)| plus dependent pairs counts 2q^5+q^4-2q^3 in V, multiplied by q^6 for central parts. Independent brute-force q=2,3 produced V pair totals 64 and 513 exactly; finite checks support but do not prove arbitrary field results.
residual_risks: The claim is for one specified bracket integral form, not arbitrary quaternionic division-algebra specializations or all nilpotent Lie algebras.
